config.title: Highlight Configuration
config.wholeWord.description: Whether to highlight whole words only.
config.ignoreCase.description: Whether to ignore case when highlighting.
config.colors.description: Colors used for highlighting. Each color may add optional "textLight"/"textDark" values used when renderStyle is "text", falling back to "light"/"dark" when omitted.
config.colors.item.name: Optional display name shown when picking a color.
config.colors.item.light: Color used in a light theme (background in "highlight" mode).
config.colors.item.dark: Color used in a dark theme (background in "highlight" mode).
config.colors.item.textLight: Color used for the text itself in light themes when renderStyle is "text" (falls back to "light").
config.colors.item.textDark: Color used for the text itself in dark themes when renderStyle is "text" (falls back to "dark").
config.bold.description: Whether the highlighted text should be bold.
config.onlySelectedOccurrence.descriptio: Highlight only the occurrence you selected, instead of every match in the document.
config.renderStyle.description: How matches are drawn: "highlight" paints a background color behind the text, "text" colors the text itself instead.
config.renderStyle.enum.highlight: Paint a background color behind the match (classic highlight).
config.renderStyle.enum.text: Color the text itself, without any background.
config.debug.description: Log debug information to a file (see Output panel > Highlight for the file path).
config.disableHighlight.description: Turn highlighting off without losing the highlighted words (toggle with the Highlight: Toggle Highlighting command).
